bio_draft: Kalbaisakhi is the Delhi producer and DJ Vibhu Singh, who started with lo-fi and hip hop instrumentals on the 2020 EP Tunnels and later moved to house, UK garage and bass along with Bollywood and Punjabi edits. He spent time in London's rave scene and co-runs New Delhi Community Radio.
notes: Savaal (Jan 2021) and High On Score describe Kalbaisakhi as a Delhi duo (Vibhu Singh and Vikramaditya) at the time of Tunnels, with Vibhu as producer; later sources treat it as his solo project. Spotify id comes from Music Metrics Vault (names Vibhu Singh, Delhi, and says based in London; that data is marked possibly outdated, and Rolling Stone India 2025 says he is back in India). Rolling Stone India also mentions a 'Yeh Mera Dil' rework with Lush Lata and work with Kimeraa, no dates. bandcamp.com/klbski is a fan account, not an artist page. No other mixes found before the search budget ran out.

south_asian.evidence: Rolling Stone India: Vibhu Singh, roots in Delhi, now back in India running a community radio show.
